title: Personal agent flow
lede: Sam asks Muse for something. Muse-detect looks first, then Privilege checks who may call the tool and whether this call is allowed. Everything here is simulated.

nodes.label: Coarse check
sub: Which personas may call the tool

steps.title: Sam asks Muse
steps.what: Muse takes the request from Sam's signed-in session.

steps.title: Muse-detect
steps.what: A DaVinci-shaped flow looks for bursts of calls and instructions hidden in tool arguments. A block stops the call here.

steps.title: Coarse check
steps.what: Privilege asks whether this persona may call the tool at all. A deny stops the call here.

steps.title: Fine check
steps.what: Privilege applies the business rule to this call. Over the limit, the call is held until a person approves it.

steps.title: Resource
steps.what: The call is allowed, so the tool runs.
